text:
releasebot: Hotfix queued: kv-ttl-fastpatch -> canary. Window 03:05-03:20 UTC. Trigger: embed 503 spike. Paging @oncall SRE.

tia: oncall here. Requesting expedited approval to accelerate to 30% if canary shows no errors for 2 minutes. Customer impact is high. :rotating_light:

omar: eng +1. Change is small: TTL tweak + guard in cache write. Image pinned to sha: c0ffee123. No DB or model changes. Need rollback readiness in <60s.

sre_lina: setting abort triggers: error-rate > 0.8% sustained 60s OR p99 > 300ms. I'll keep EU traffic on stable until I give green.

tia: ops checklist below:
```
- deploybot deploy --env=canary --image=redwood/hotfix:c0ffee123
- healthcheck: curl -fsS https://svc.internal/health || exit 1
- monitors: embeddings-503, kv-cache-errors, embed-p99
- rollback: deploybot rollback --to-sha=prev-99aa
```

opsbot: preflight OK: image exists, infra quotas OK, canary nodes ready, CI artifact verified. No blocking alerts.

deploybot: Canary started on 2 pods (sha c0ffee123). Opening ephemeral channel and notifying #incidents.

sre_lina: watching dashboards. lowering page thresholds for this thread.

opsbot: canary minute 1: errors 0.5%, p99 130ms. minute 2: errors 0.2%, p99 125ms. Burn-in passed.

tia: starting fastcut to 30% traffic. Pin applied.

omar: eng on standby for immediate rollback if SRE asks. Previous image sha noted.

opsbot: post-cut quick checks: 2m avg errors 0.24%, p99 140ms. Monitoring 10m.

sre_lina: EU remains isolated; will approve global widen after EU metrics stable for 5m.

docbot: Draft release note: "hotfix: tighten kv cache TTL and guard atomic writes to prevent intermittent 503s on embed. pinned c0ffee123." Link: https://docs.internal/releases/1725111111-kv-fastpatch

omar: approved as release owner.

opsbot: +8m: errors steady 0.18%, p99 145ms, no pages.

sre_lina: EU metrics are green for 6m. Approving widen to full rollout.

tia: proceeding to full rollout now. Rolling window open.

opsbot: full rollout complete. Observing 15m window. Current errors 0.15%, p99 150ms. No alerts.

sre_lina: final: no rollback needed. Closing ephemeral channel in 5. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
